correctness.rationale: For µ>0 radial-square control bounds |w| and the linear z equation bounds z. For 0<µ<=588/6575 the reduced (r,z) divergence is -1-µ[5(r²-25/14)²+400z²/21-6575/588], nonpositive and strictly negative in area, excluding closed cycles and saddle homoclinics; the only meridional fixed points are sinks q0,q2 and saddle q1. Standard Poincare-Bendixson yields convergence of each orbit to one equilibrium. The exact angular coboundary d(arg w+ez)/dt=1 gives phase and conjugacy; recurrence confines invariant measures to the origin and two circles and forces the three-vertex probability simplex. Independent exact symbolic expansion verified divergence. The source proof applies to compact forward-invariant sets and continuous-time invariant measures; no claim on µ above cutoff.
residual_risks: Independent finite checks do not replace all-parameter reasoning.
